meta.confirmedMeaning: true = read directly on the product page (or its loaded category/JSON data) by the researching agent; false = from a search-engine snippet or secondary listing describing the retailer's own page.
meta.scope: Adds ONLY brands not already present in the game's existing clothing-brands.json for each category (swimwear, sleepwear, underwear [incl. bras/lingerie/socks], hosiery, thermals). Does not duplicate or replace any existing brand/product data.
